# Bifrost

## What is Bifrost?
Bifrost is an intelligent AI execution layer. It routes, optimizes, caches, validates, and recovers AI requests across multiple model providers through a single OpenAI-compatible API.

## Core Capabilities
- **Routing**: Automatic model/provider selection based on capability, cost, latency, health, and quota
- **Optimization**: Prompt compression, tool output compression, context pruning, deduplication
- **Caching**: Exact match and semantic similarity caching
- **Reliability**: Automatic fallback, circuit breakers, self-healing, multi-account rotation
- **Control**: Policy-as-code, budgets, quotas, data residency, tenant isolation
- **Observability**: Full request tracing, cost attribution, provider health monitoring

## API
Base URL: https://bifrost.omixsystems.store/v1
Compatible with OpenAI API format.

### Endpoints
- POST /v1/chat/completions — Chat completions with routing and optimization
- GET /v1/models — List all available models across providers

## Architecture
Application → Bifrost → Understand → Optimize → Cache → Predict → Route → Execute → Validate → Recover → Observe

## Providers
OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, Groq, Cerebras, SambaNova, OpenRouter, Cloudflare, HuggingFace, Ollama Cloud, Zen, Bytez, Ollama (local)

## Enterprise
- Policy-as-code with visual and YAML modes
- Tenant isolation and multi-account support
- Data residency controls
- Budget and quota enforcement
